tasks.short: Calculate, measure and record radiopharmaceutical quantities

steps.what: Measure radiopharmaceuticals and verify computer calculations against the prescription and material identity
outputs: verified activity and transaction field set

steps.what: Populate radiation dosage records from verified measurement and transaction fields
inputs: verified activity and transaction field set

steps.what: Check dosage record identity, units and transaction details before posting
inputs: verified activity and transaction field set
outputs: checked dosage and stock transaction record

tasks.design: Use native import in the nuclear medicine record system category represented by {OPS_SYSTEM} to populate checked transaction fields. Measurement, existing computer calculation and prescription checks remain with the technologist, who approves the exact record before posting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Already calculated values may still be recopied into receipt, use or disposal records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record interfaces can avoid repeat transcription where an export is available.
tasks.still_hard: Verifying the physical material, measurement context, units and prescription.
tasks.human_edge: Detect mismatched material or implausible readings before they enter the record.
tasks.altitude: Control measurement provenance and record reconciliation.

reach.learn: Preserve units, reference times and source identity

evidence.claim: Importing checked measurement fields can remove duplicate entry; nuclear medicine integration and savings remain unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: The physician produces the prescription through the unchanged prescribing process before s1. No prescribing effort is claimed as saved.

In s1 the technologist operates the instrument and captures material or batch identity, patient or stock reference, transaction type, activity, units, measurement time and source reference. Measurement, existing calculation, field verification and missing data resolution remain in its 50 hours.
The instrument produces the numeric reading; the technologist supplies its physical context. No safe dose or disposal clearance flag is inferred.
Unavailable export or a mismatched unit or identity triggers manual record entry and review in s3.
Native import is checked first. No saving is assigned to the computer calculation already named in the task; physical administration and disposal are outside this recording proposal.
research_questions: Can native import reduce total record effort without increasing identity or unit corrections?

already_counted.description: Measurement, calculation checks, field capture and posting review

approvals.approved_version: Exact transaction record, material identity, quantity, units and reference time; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=75 yields 25 gross and 16 net after 9 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-3 reflects an already computer assisted task and uncertain duplicate entry.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify procedure identity and capture source references for results processing
Place results and source links into the prescribed processing record
Process results, check completeness and approve the record before filing

tasks.design: Configure native result transfer in the clinical record and imaging system category represented by {OPS_SYSTEM}. The interface places existing outputs without interpreting them; the technologist retains substantive processing and approves filing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing procedure outputs may be copied or relinked manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native result interfaces can place supplied fields and stable source links.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether the procedure output is complete and suitable for further clinical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise anomalies that a complete looking record can conceal.
tasks.altitude: Own result traceability and exceptions rather than repeat entry.

reach.learn: Trace each value and image to its source procedure

evidence.claim: Native result transfer can remove repeat entry while substantive processing remains human; the proposed labour effect is E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: The acquisition system produces procedure outputs during the unchanged acquisition task, before s1; no acquisition saving is claimed.

In s1 the technologist captures and verifies patient identity, procedure identifier, acquisition date, output type and stable source references. Retrieval, manual capture and missing identity resolution are counted in 35 hours.
The interface uses only checked source fields, never an unproduced normality or diagnostic flag. Missing or inconsistent outputs are processed manually in s3.
This task owns imaging and procedure result records; dosage and stock entries belong only to task 4148, preventing double counting.
Existing native transfer is tested before custom integration; already automatic sites have zero saving.
unknowns: Share of processing requiring manual professional work
research_questions: What time remains after source verification, substantive processing and reconciliation are counted?

already_counted.description: Source manifest capture, substantive processing and filing checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact results record, patient, procedure and source links; changes invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=65 gives 35 gross and 27 net after 8 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-5 allows existing interfaces and retained substantive processing; no acquisition or dosage record savings are duplicated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare stock radiopharmaceuticals while applying exposure controls and checking material suitability

tasks.design: Retain physical preparation and exposure control with the qualified technologist. The digest's examples of other pharmacy robots do not establish this task's automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical preparation and radioactive handling require controlled facilities and professional checks.
tasks.enabler_now: No applicable replacement is established by the supplied evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Maintain preparation quality while limiting exposure.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a material or handling condition that requires stopping preparation.
tasks.altitude: Improve preparation reliability and exposure discipline.

reach.learn: Respect the boundaries of radioactive preparation

evidence.claim: The digest documents APOTECAchemo compounding cytostatics, which does not establish automated radiopharmaceutical stock preparation.
Retaining physical stock preparation yields no modelled labour saving here.

assumptions: The technologist performs material identification and preparation checks in s1; no readiness or safety flag is supplied free of work.
Record entry and dosage calculations belong to separate tasks and receive no savings here.
No new robot or software is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which preparation defects or handling difficulties require process improvement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: physical preparation and exposure controls remain fully counted; zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Explain procedures and safety precautions and assist patients throughout their tests

tasks.design: Keep explanation and assistance with the technologist at the patient's side. Written instructions do not replace checking understanding or practical help.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patients have individual concerns and may need assistance during the test.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported means of replacing this direct care is established.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt explanations to distress, uncertainty and physical needs.
tasks.human_edge: Notice difficulty and respond in the moment.
tasks.altitude: Improve patient understanding and practical support.

reach.learn: Recognise when clinical staff must answer a personal question

evidence.claim: Explanation and physical assistance are retained as direct patient care; no labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Patient questions and observed needs emerge during s1 and their clarification is fully counted.
No structured understanding or readiness flag is assumed.
No deployment is added and upkeep remains zero.
research_questions: Where do patients most often need an explanation repeated or practical help?

already_counted.description: Explanation, understanding checks and patient assistance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100: all patient explanation and assistance time remains, with zero gross and net savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Control result and measurement provenance while preserving hands on preparation and patient care.
reach: Help records colleagues resolve incomplete procedure links
role.ambitious_version: A technologist who avoids duplicate transcription and retains professional checks, preparation discipline and patient attention.
